resources.string: Only OpenAI and gateways that implement prompt cache retention accept this. Nothing is sent by default. From GPT-5.6 on, 30m and 12h use prompt_cache_options.ttl (12h is Responses only); GPT-5.5 / 5.5 Pro use a 24h option, and older models use prompt_cache_retention=24h. Cache write pricing follows the provider and model: newer 30m/12h options can carry a write premium (e.g. 1.25x / 2.5x), while legacy prompt caching usually has no extra write fee.
